chain.reason/text: No earlier packet on this ticket was reviewed, so this packet covers the whole change.

h:67c919ec.patch:
@@ -941,8 +942,9 @@ start|ensure)
   if [ "$external" = true ]; then
     [ -z "$pr_stale" ] \
       || die "$ticket is STALE: PR #$pr_number moved to ${pr_stale:0:12}. Its review stays bound to ${review_head:0:12}; nothing is built." 7
-    is_sha "$review_head" && is_sha "$review_base" \
-      || die "$ticket records no pinned PR base and head; run kk-packet import again" 4

       die "$ticket is pinned to PR #$pr_number's base and head; --base and --head cannot change them"
     fi
